query: 供应商申诉机制 供应商申诉机制 衡量企业为供应商提供的正式沟通与举报渠道。重点考察申诉渠道的独立性、匿名保护能力、反报复政策、处理时限以及重大争议的升级处理机制。 一、内容质量得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（卓越）：设有独立的第三方举报平台或由审计/合规部门直管的匿名渠道；具备书面的《供应商反报复政策》；明确了申诉处理的时限（如 15 个工作日内给予实质性答复）；并有高级管理层参与的争议调解与升级路径。 • 1分（合格）：提供了采购部门外的申诉联系方式（如廉洁邮箱、热线），有基础的受理与记录流程，但缺乏第三方独立性、具体的处理时限承诺或系统性的反报复保护细则。 • 0分（不合格）：无针对供应商的正式申诉渠道披露，或仅提供采购员个人联系方式。 二、覆盖应用得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（高覆盖）：申诉机制覆盖 >80% 的供应商（按采购额或数量计），且在供应商系统（SRM）、合同附件或年度供应商大会中进行了明确告知。 • 1分（部分覆盖）：占比 >0% - 80%，或仅核心供应商知晓该渠道，或未披露具体告知与覆盖比例。 • 0分（无覆盖）：无相关覆盖范围信息。 供应商申诉机制 供应商举报 供应商诉说渠道 供应商反报复 采购廉洁热线 供应商争议升级 SRM supplier grievance mechanism supplier whistleblowing supplier speak-up anti-retaliation for suppliers procurement integrity hotline supplier dispute escalation SRM 供应商可用的正式申诉/举报渠道有哪些？ 是否独立于采购员个人联系方式并支持匿名？ 是否有书面反报复政策与处理时限？ 重大争议如何升级到高层？ 机制覆盖多少供应商，是否告知供应商？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '供应商申诉机制'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 供应商可用的正式申诉/举报渠道有哪些？ 是否独立于采购员个人联系方式并支持匿名？ 是否有书面反报复政策与处理时限？ 重大争议如何升级到高层？ 机制覆盖多少供应商，是否告知供应商？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅有员工申诉热线；仅有采购员微信/电话；仅有供应商行为准则而无申诉入口；仅有客户投诉渠道；区分：供应商申诉机制服务供应商；员工申诉服务员工；举报人保护偏内部舞弊举报；有行为准则不等于已建立供应商可及申诉渠道。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

results.text: The Group also strictly follows the Code of Conduct Manual, which sets out the operational standards of Sinofert, regulates the compliance behavior of employees, and the standards that we expect our business partners to follow. Managers are required to ensure that employees have received, read, and understood the standards, and to ensure that these standards are implemented in their daily work. Managers can regularly share the cases related to the code of conduct and compliance, organize training, and provide support and guidance at any time to encourage and lead employees' compliance behaviors. All employees must read and understand the code of conduct and sign a letter of commitment to the code of conduct every year. All employees are obliged to immediately report to the Discipline Inspection and Audit and Compliance Department when aware of or suspecting any violation of the code of conduct. Involved issues will then be handled by the Discipline and Compliance Department. In addition, we have also established various reporting channels, and conduct regular updates and maintenance on reporting platforms such as letters, reporting hotlines, emails, and QR codes, to encourage employees and other stakeholders to report any misconduct, dishonest behavior, and corruption. Whistleblowing can be conducted in real name or anonymously to prevent any retaliation against the whistleblower and create a corporate atmosphere where anyone can voice out and speak up.

All employees are obliged to immediately report to the Discipline Inspection and Audit and Compliance Department when aware of or suspecting any violation of the code of conduct. Involved issues will then be handled by the Discipline and Compliance Department. In addition, we have also established various reporting channels, and conduct regular updates and maintenance on reporting platforms such as letters, reporting hotlines, emails, and QR codes, to encourage employees and other stakeholders to report any misconduct, dishonest behavior, and corruption. Whistleblowing can be conducted in real name or anonymously to prevent any retaliation against the whistleblower and create a corporate atmosphere where anyone can voice out and speak up.

results.text: Sinofert continues to maintain fluid communication with its customers. We have established a sound customer service system to receive and take care of complaints and opinions regarding product quality, which aims to improve customers' experience and satisfaction. In this respect, the Group continued to enhance the responsibilities of corresponding departments and set up a complete working mechanism to satisfy the needs of customers continuously. During the Reporting Period, the Group received 16 complaints regarding our products and services. We follow up and communicate with our customers promptly whenever customers provide us feedback on product issues or raise questions on our sales distribution website. The Group strives to maintain a good brand image, and if the complaints cannot be resolved through communication, the Group will organize relevant units to provide technical consultation for customers, conduct external investigations, offer technical on-site services if necessary, and provide essential explanations and reassurance to customers involved in the incident.

results.text: During the Reporting Period, the Group actively carried out anti-corruption education for our directors and employees, focusing on the four themes of 'learning and publicizing the spirit of the important conference', 'promoting and interpreting the Party's rules and regulations', 'nurturing the Group's core values and code of conduct' and 'strengthening the construction of an ethical workplace and promoting integrity'. We have carried out 9 on-site education and training programs, covering the Board, the management level, and non-management employees as many as 432 people participating. In addition, we also uploaded video courses for new employees on ethical practices and work integrity to the Pioneer Camp App. Through the exposure and analysis of external cases of violations of laws and disciplines, and organizing the warning education documentaries watching such as 'Integrity and Anti-corruption Around You' and 'National Supervision', we focus on the introduction of laws and regulations such as the Regulations on the Implementation of Supervision Law, and the Opinions on Further Promoting the Investigation of Bribery, which hopefully helps all party members and employees to firmly establish the value of integrity and compliance of 'adhering to the bottom line of discipline, being loyal and ethical, and encouraging outspokenness'.
